40f2edc feat: sync-template now shows total diff with NEW/existing separation [90m(27/12/2025)[0m
  BREAKING CHANGE: sync-template behavior changed to support incremental syncing
  
  Previous behavior (BROKEN):
  - Only showed changes since last sync
  - If you applied partial changes, unapplied changes were lost
  - "No new template commits" blocked seeing existing differences
  
  New behavior (FIXED):
  - Always shows TOTAL diff (current state vs current state)
  - Separates changes into:
    * NEW since last sync (highlighted)
    * Existing differences (greyed out)
  - Supports incremental workflow:
    1. Apply safe changes first
    2. Come back later for conflicts
    3. Never lose track of unapplied changes
  
  Display changes:
  - "Safe changes - NEW since last sync" (normal color)
  - "Safe changes - existing differences" (grey)
  - "Conflicts - NEW since last sync" (normal color)
  - "Conflicts - existing differences" (grey)
  
  This matches --diff-summary behavior and enables proper incremental syncing.
  
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  
  Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

1aa9369 fix: loading states showing false empty state before data loads [90m(27/12/2025)[0m
  CRITICAL UX FIX: Components were showing 'No items' empty state while
  data was still loading, confusing users with false empty states.
  
  Changes:
  - Fix Todos.tsx to check loading state before showing empty state
  - Add 'Loading States - CRITICAL UX Pattern' section to:
    - app-guildelines/React-components-guidelines.md
    - docs/state-management.md
    - docs/caching-strategy.md
    - .cursor/rules/react-component-organization.mdc
  
  The correct pattern is: Loading → Error → Empty → Data
  - isLoading=true && !data → Loading spinner
  - error → Error message
  - !data → Unable to load
  - data.length === 0 → Empty state (ONLY when truly empty)
  - data.length > 0 → Show data
